name: Barbara Gaines
office: Antelope Valley Community College District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 5

items.text: Barbara Gaines is vice president of the Antelope Valley Community College District board. Her career in public education includes roles as teacher, principal, and superintendent. She supports building career technical education pathways, like aerospace, with local high schools. In a 2024 statement, she said the board passed a $350 million bond with 71% approval in 2016. She also supports establishing diversity, equity, inclusion and access at the college.
